title: DDP buckets overlap backward
scope: 2 dense Qwen-shaped layers · 9 measured reducer buckets

verification.label: Measured bucketed PyTorch DDP · rank 0 compute and NCCL streams
verification.implementation: PyTorch 2.9.1 DistributedDataParallel with a 96 MiB bucket cap, gradient bucket views, and the default all-reduce hook
verification.workload: Same two dense Qwen-shaped layers and 893,428,736 BF16 gradient bytes as the terminal-bucket task; only reducer bucketization changes
verification.measurement: 28.705 ms synchronized step; 28.203 ms displayed rank-0 GPU window; 0.926 ms exposed communication tail
verification.timeline: Clean Nsight timing correlated with a separate module-labeled capture; bucket composition comes directly from GradBucket.parameters().

description: DDP rebuilds the reducer order from observed backward readiness. With a 96 MiB cap, this model forms nine buckets. A bucket launches only after every parameter it contains has a gradient; this is why one bucket can cross a layer boundary.

The early all-reduces overlap useful backward compute, but overlap is imperfect: concurrent NCCL increases the measured compute envelopes and collective durations through resource contention. Bucketization cuts the exposed tail from 4.00 ms to 0.93 ms, not to zero.

blocks.description: Bucket 0 contains output.weight, norm.weight, and layers.1.feed_forward.w2.weight: 102,768,640 bytes. The earlier root gradients wait for the L1 down-projection gradient, which is the last member to become ready.

blocks.label: Layer 1 attention gradient all-reduce
blocks.description: Bucket 3 contains L1 FFN norm plus Q, K, V, output-projection, and Q/K norm gradients: 142,615,040 bytes. It launches after L1 attention backward completes.

blocks.label: L1 attention norm and L0 down-projection gradient all-reduce
blocks.description: Bucket 4 crosses a layer boundary: layers.1.attention_norm.weight shares 100,671,488 bytes with layers.0.feed_forward.w2.weight. The ready L1 norm gradient waits until L0 down-projection backward supplies the bucket's final gradient.

blocks.label: Layer 0 attention gradient all-reduce
blocks.description: Bucket 7 contains L0 FFN norm and attention projection/norm gradients: 142,615,040 bytes. Only 0.219 ms overlaps remaining compute, so most of this collective is exposed.

blocks.label: Embedding and L0 attention-norm gradient all-reduce
blocks.description: The final 2,105,344-byte bucket contains the token embedding and L0 attention norm. It closes the measured 0.926 ms communication tail.
